Household & Shopping

Ingredient quantities on each meal are written for 4 people and scale automatically to your household size (edit them under Meals below — tap a meal, then "Ingredients"). Mark an ingredient "Per person" there to give it a flat per-head amount instead — handy for meat/fish where you know your portion size (e.g. 125g each). See the shopping list from the Shopping List tab.

Protein portions

Set a flat per-person amount for an ingredient once here (e.g. Chicken breast = 125g), then tap "Apply to all meals" to push it onto every meal that uses that ingredient — tick "Per person" on any of them individually too and it'll pick up this rate.

Monthly tasks

Tap a tickbox to mark a chore done — stars are earned automatically. Fortnightly chores alternate between Week A and Week B; use the toggle in the week bar if a chore's week looks off.

Everything that isn't a daily chore, in one place — so you can get ahead of the week, fortnight or month without waiting for it to show up on a particular day.
